notes: v0.13: Day and night. Mire stalkers fear light, stay in the swamp by day and raid at night for food, houses and people; guards patrol, everyone else hides; knocked-down villagers are dragged off and eaten unless rescued. Houses take damage and get repaired. 9-month pregnancies, babies carried to age 2. New villager art and animation. Graveyard list. Tech tree: Food, Health, Population, Crafting, Lore, Magic, Leadership, five levels each; houses and the lore table have five looks. Harder food: lower berry yield, sources run dry and regrow. Three flint pieces hidden on the southwest point. Forest cutting thins gradually and turns the deadfall into a wood store. Reworked quarry. Info boxes on the top bar. Speeds pause/0.25/0.5/1/2/3 and a simulated Supporter Pack (5 save slots). Crickets removed.
